claims.claim: TSMC expects A16 to be ready in 2026 with volume production beginning in 2027.
claims.source_title: TSMC's A16 chip process is arriving early, and Intel can't catch up
claims.supporting_quote: TSMC expects its A16 process, a 1.6-nanometer-class node designed for high-performance computing, to move from production readiness in 2026 to volume production in 2027.

claims.claim: Versus N2P, A16 delivers 8 to 10 percent faster performance at the same power, or 15 to 20 percent less power at the same speed, and roughly 8 to 10 percent higher density.
claims.episode_span: 8 to 10 percent faster performance at the same power
claims.source_title: TSMC's A16 chip process is arriving early, and Intel can't catch up
claims.supporting_quote: Compared with TSMC's N2P node, it delivers 8 to 10% faster performance at the same power draw, or 15 to 20% less power at the same speed, plus roughly 8 to 10% higher transistor density.

claims.claim: High-NA EUV tools run north of 350 million euros each.
claims.source_title: TSMC's A16 chip process is arriving early, and Intel can't catch up
claims.supporting_quote: They run north of 350 million euros each.

claims.claim: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan said high-volume 14A production is committed for 2028, with risk production for internal chips in the second half of 2027.
claims.source_title: TSMC's A16 chip process is arriving early, and Intel can't catch up
claims.supporting_quote: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan said this year that the company has fully committed to high-volume 14A production in 2028, with risk production for internal chips starting in the second half of 2027.

claims.claim: Samsung's SF1.4 node is not targeting mass production until 2029.
claims.source_title: TSMC's A16 chip process is arriving early, and Intel can't catch up
claims.supporting_quote: Samsung's answer, the SF1.4 node, isn't targeting mass production until 2029, two years later than the target Samsung announced in 2022.

claims.claim: AMD third-quarter 2026 revenue was $13.4 billion and Data Center revenue was $8.5 billion, up 97 percent year over year.
claims.episode_span: Data Center revenue was a record $8.5 billion, up 97 percent
claims.source_title: AMD Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
claims.supporting_quote: Data Center segment revenue was a record $8.5 billion, up 97% year-over-year, driven by strong demand for AMD EPYC™ processors and the launch of AMD Instinct™ MI450 Series GPUs.

claims.claim: Intel released PDK 0.9 for 14A in late October and expects PDK 1.0 in the first quarter of 2027.
claims.episode_span: process design kit version 0.9 for the 14A node
claims.source_title: Intel Releases 0.9 PDK for 14A Node, Final Version in Q1 2027
claims.supporting_quote: In late October, Intel released its process design kit (PDK) version 0.9 for the 14A node, marking a significant milestone for the Intel Foundry business.

claims.claim: TerraVolt acquired 1,077 acres in Cassia County, Idaho, to develop a 240 megawatt gas-powered behind-the-meter data center campus.
claims.source_title: TerraVolt acquires site in Idaho to develop 240MW gas powered behind-the-meter data center campus

claims.claim: TSMC is scheduled to list NT$14.8 billion in green bonds on November 12, split into NT$12.4 billion of five-year bonds at 2.30 percent and NT$2.4 billion of ten-year bonds at 2.42 percent.
claims.episode_span: list NT$14.8 billion, about $450 million, in green bonds
claims.source_title: TSMC scheduled to list NT$14.8 billion green bonds on Nov. 12
claims.supporting_quote: TSMC said the green bonds will be made up of two tranches: NT$12.4 billion of five-year bonds with a coupon rate of 2.30 percent, and NT$2.4 billion of 10-year bonds with a rate of 2.42 percent.

claims.claim: ES2's stated objective is to improve U.S. data center energy efficiency by 20 to 35 percent.
claims.source_title: Accelsius Supports NSF Data Center Efficiency Research at Villanova
claims.supporting_quote: With support from fellow industry partners including Google, Microsoft and Meta, ES2’s stated objective is to improve the energy efficiency of U.S. data centers by 20–35% — by its own estimate, the equivalent of removing one to two power plants every three years.
